page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, which supports high-throughput data transfers between cloud resources.

The hardware profile of the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources without the overhead of specialized hardware. It is suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, medium-sized databases, and general-purpose business-critical workloads.
